The Chinese characters for Elias

As a transliteration, Elias is usually written 埃利亚斯 (Āi lì yà sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

埃
Āi
dust
利
lì
sharp, benefit
亚
yà
Asia, second
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Elias carries the meaning “my God is Yahweh (form of Elijah)”.

About the name Elias

The Greek form of Elijah, carried by several early saints.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “my God is Yahweh (form of Elijah)”, an Elias calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
